description: Ministry of Irrigation - Subjects and Functions to State Minister
categorisation: This gazette notification names a specific individual (Roshan Ranasinghe, Minister of Irrigation) and assigns detailed portfolio responsibilities and functions to the State Minister of Irrigation, including flood control, environmental pollution prevention, seawater elimination schemes, and assisting with development projects. The content contains both the "who" (named government person) and the "what" (detailed government responsibilities), making it a Hybrid Gazette according to the classification rules.
